_doc: Perk tonics. Effects are applied by autoload/perk_manager.gd via effect keys. T-082: every tonic has a one-line 'desc' (the pause menu's perk list, PauseMenu.perk_desc) and its cap glyph is drawn by ui/perk_cap.gd ('abbr' is only the fallback for a tonic without a glyph case). Base measures raised ~10-15% in T-082 (PERKS_LORE.md section 1.0).
_cap_doc: T-081: a survivor holds up to `cap` tonics (PerkManager.base_cap / cap_for); Classic Rules (Settings) keeps the genre's old four (`classic_cap`). Read once per match (the host's value in co-op). Extra slots on top: the Map 1 egg's permanent slot (cap_for). A bot's bonus perk and the tonic tiers take no slot.

ironhide_stout.name: Ironhide Stout
ironhide_stout.desc: Thicker skin: you stand a sixth hit that would have dropped anyone else.

2.name: Riveted Hoops
2.desc: Seven hits instead of six, and your health starts coming back 40% sooner.

3.name: Sunday Best
3.desc: A hit that leaves you under 30% health turns your skin to iron for 2 s: nothing gets through. Once every 40 s.

second_wind.name: Second Wind Schnapps
second_wind.desc: You get the fallen up in a fraction of the time; alone, it stands you back up itself, three times a match.

2.name: Breathe Again
2.desc: Revives go 25% faster again, and whoever you get up (you too, after a self-revive) runs 30% faster for 5 s.

3.name: The Nurse's Count
3.desc: The revived get 3 s where nothing can hurt them, and getting up knocks every zombie within 4 m off its feet.

trigger_tonic.name: Trigger Tonic
trigger_tonic.desc: Every reload done in well under half the time, on every gun you carry.

2.name: Shift Quota
2.desc: Swap weapons 40% faster, and reloads shave off a little more.

3.name: Fresh Clip
3.desc: For 2 s after a reload finishes, your shots deal 30% more damage.

twin_barrel.name: Twin Barrel Bitters
twin_barrel.desc: Every gun fires half as fast again, from the pistol to the machine gun.

2.name: The Major's Moustache
2.desc: A touch faster again, and the gun climbs 30% less as you fire.

3.name: Both Barrels
3.desc: One shot in four doesn't use a round.

marathon_malt.name: Marathon Malt
marathon_malt.desc: Sprint as long as you like, and move a step quicker everywhere.

2.name: Running Home
2.desc: Faster on your feet, and the gun comes up out of a sprint almost at once.

3.name: Vreni's Step
3.desc: Sprinting, you sidestep one swipe every 8 s (no damage) and get a 1.5 s burst of speed.

hawkeye_brandy.name: Hawkeye Brandy
hawkeye_brandy.desc: Steadier sights that come up quicker, and a headshot hits a good deal harder.

2.name: The Owl
2.desc: A headshot kill puts a round back in the magazine.

3.name: Sowa's Patience
3.desc: An aimed shot taken 1.2 s or more after your last one hits 75% harder.

packmule_porter.name: Packmule Porter
packmule_porter.desc: Room for a third gun on your back, and one more grenade on your belt.

2.name: Ammer's Ledger
2.desc: Ammo at the chalk and at ammo boxes costs half, and you carry another grenade.

3.name: Training Load
3.desc: At the start of every round each gun you carry gets 20% of its reserve back, and you get a grenade.

blastproof_bock.name: Blastproof Bock
blastproof_bock.desc: Your own explosives and a long fall can't hurt you, and a slide sends a shockwave through the pack.

2.name: Liability Waiver
2.desc: Explosions that reach you heal you 25 instead, and the slide shockwave hits harder.

3.name: Demolition School
3.desc: The slide shockwave grows with the round (at least 60% of a zombie's health), reaches further and knocks survivors down.

overclock_cordial.name: Overclock Cordial
overclock_cordial.desc: Reloading an emptier magazine lets off a static burst that shocks everything near you.
overclock_cordial._doc: WEAPONS.md section 20.2: reloading releases a static burst scaling with how empty the mag was (e = 1 - mag/mag_size). Wired by PerkManager.overclock_reload (called from WeaponHolder.start_reload and on an overheat vent). Shape 'coil' shares the cabinet footprint 0.8 x 2.3 x 0.6 (Map 0 placement). 'neon' is the sign/spark colour (violet) over the teal enamel 'color' (and the bolt on its cap). T-082: radius 2.5 + 4.0 e (was 3.5 e), damage 0.66 x health(r) x e (was 0.6), bosses 1700 e (was 1500), 12 targets (was 10).

2.name: Live Wire
2.desc: The burst recharges in 2 s, and arcs jump to 3 more zombies up to twice its reach (half damage).

3.name: Aftershock
3.desc: A burst from a magazine 75% empty or more rings again 0.8 s later at half strength.

upgrades._doc: Perk upgrades (DECISIONS T-075, docs/gravelight/PERKS_LORE.md section 1). Each perk has tiers 2 and 3 ('tiers' in its row): bought in the match at the machine you already drank from (hold Use), once the power is on and the round is at least min_round; the profile-wide gate is mastery: points earned with the perk in your system (per_kill for every kill, per_round for every round you finish holding it) unlock each tier for good (unlock). A tier's effects merge over the perk's own (same key = the tier's value). Tiers count no extra cap slot, go with the perk when it is lost, and carry with it (campaign exfil, co-op snapshot). marks = the HUD cap's tier mark.
